accessibility-auditor: Audits codebase files and configurations for compliance with digital accessibility standards (WCAG).
agent-alignment-auditor: Audits agent prompts, configurations, and workflows for consistency, style, formatting, and token limits.
ai-robustness-hardener: Audits AI/ML components and LLM integrations, configuring secure input/output guardrails.
api-contract-architect: Audits API boundaries, designs schemas, and integrates Buf/Spectral Linters.
appsec-hardener: Audits security configurations and scaffolds secure HTTP header middlewares, CORS, and rate limits.
compliance-auditor: Audits and scaffolds security and compliance configurations for industry standards (SOC 2, ISO 27001).
data-pipeline-architect: Audits data workflows, schemas, retries, and database connection pool configurations.
deployment-engineer: Audits container files, HA replicas, Kubernetes probes, and backup scripts.
embedded-systems-auditor: Audits low-level firmware robustness, static analysis (MISRA), and compiler warning flags.
state-integrity-auditor: Audits codebase state machines, specifications (TLA+), and proof verification harnesses.
fuzz-engineer: Audits parsing blocks to identify crash-prone sections and scaffolds fuzz-testing harnesses.
legal-neutrality-auditor: Audits user-facing UI copy warning alerts, Terms of Service, and UI descriptions for legal neutrality.
notebook-auditor: Audits data science repositories and configures nbstripout pre-commit filters.
observability-engineer: Audits observability configurations, OpenTelemetry integration, and Honeycomb/Grafana dashboards.
performance-auditor: Audits codebase performance setups, benchmarking, and CI performance budgets.
privacy-hardener: Audits data storage schemas and configurations for CCPA/GDPR regulatory privacy compliance.
react-performance-auditor: Audits React client-side rendering speed, re-renders, layout shifts, and bfcache.
resilience-architect: Audits fault-tolerance configurations, retry policies, backoffs, and circuit breakers.
state-hardener: Audits React codebase hooks and states for stale closures, memory leaks, and async fetch race conditions.
supply-chain-auditor: Audits codebase dependencies for vulnerabilities and copyleft licenses.
technical-scribe: Audits and scaffolds ADR documentation systems and generates architecture flowcharts.
qa-engineer: Audits and configures unit, integration, and E2E test runners and code coverage gates.
tool-auditor: Audits recommended packages and libraries against security databases and licensing rules.
tooling-engineer: Safely installs tools and edits config files using AST-based modifications.
toolchain-architect: Audits build target constraints and cross-compilation toolchain parameters.
vcs-workflow-engineer: Audits and configures pre-commit hooks, Conventional Commit validations, and copyright headers.
maintainability-auditor: Audits codebase structure, DRY compliance, and identifies Fowler code smells tailored to development profiles.
database-lifecycle-auditor: Audits database migrations, schemas, and queries for complexity and performance patterns based on inferred stacks.
